name: Bespoke Bathroom UK
one_liner: One team designs your bathroom in 3D, supplies every piece and fits it for you.
location: [ADD: town or city and showroom address, if there is one]
service_area: [ADD: areas the fitting team covers]. Products and the 3D design studio are available UK-wide.
positioning: A bathroom company that does the whole job. Design, supply and fitting usually mean three companies and three chances for the room to drift away from what you wanted. Here the designer, the range and the fitters belong to one team: what you approve on screen is what gets ordered, and what gets ordered is what gets fitted.
services: Free 3D Design Studio: set a budget from £1,000 to £100,000, pick a mood, a metal finish and a style (from Spanish to Japanese), drag the room to size or upload photos
Up to 4 photographs of your designed room plus a 3D room you can walk around, with every product tagged and priced (VAT included) inside your budget
A designer reviews every design and confirms stock, lead times and delivery before you pay anything
Printable design sheet with tile and flooring quantities worked out for your room
Supply from a range of 4,637 products across 22 brands, sold as a whole room or piece by piece, delivered on one plan
Fitting by qualified fitters from the company's own team, priced separately and agreed before work starts

differentiators: See it before you buy it: your own room photographed with real products, not a brochure or 'from' prices
Priced to the pound inside your budget, VAT included, before anything is ordered
One team answers for design, supply and fitting, so there is nobody to pass you on to
Fitters work from the design you approved: no second brief to get wrong
Nothing is ordered until you approve it; one order, one delivery plan, so the bath does not arrive three weeks before the taps
The design costs nothing and needs no sign-up

price_positioning: Premium range with honest, visible prices. Budgets in the studio run from £1,000 to £100,000; a website 'shop the look' room of six pieces totals £11,533.84.

audiences.name: Planning homeowners
audiences.situation: Homeowners, 30 to 65, planning a main bathroom or en-suite in the next 3 to 12 months, typical budget £8,000 to £30,000
audiences.pains: Do not know what it will cost; scared of cowboy fitters and overruns; cannot picture the finished room; juggling three companies
audiences.wants: To see it finished and priced before committing, a fixed price, one point of contact

audiences.name: Inspiration savers
audiences.situation: Interior lovers who save bathroom ideas on Pinterest and Instagram months before they renovate
audiences.pains: Endless scrolling, not sure what suits their room or budget
audiences.wants: Ideas they can actually build, material palettes, 'this vs that' guidance

audiences.name: Small-space and en-suite upgraders
audiences.situation: Flats, terraces and new-builds with small bathrooms or cloakrooms
audiences.pains: Space, storage, light, making it feel bigger
audiences.wants: Clever layouts, wall-hung pieces, walk-in showers

audiences.name: Wellness and spa seekers
audiences.situation: Higher budgets wanting a hotel-spa bathroom at home
audiences.pains: Cold, dated rooms; showers that disappoint
audiences.wants: Rain showers, freestanding baths, heating, lighting, calm

audiences.name: Trade and fitters
audiences.situation: Independent fitters and builders sourcing products for client jobs
audiences.pains: Split deliveries, missing pieces, slow quotes
audiences.wants: One order, one delivery plan, a design sheet with quantities

do: Lead with the moment the customer feels: the first quiet morning in the finished room
Use real numbers: budgets, product counts, prices, timings
Show the room, the materials and the hands that fit it
Write short sentences in British English
dont: No invented reviews, stats, awards or guarantees
No shouting, no cheap discount language
Avoid filler: elevate, unlock, seamless, world-class, game-changer, nestled, tailored solutions
words_we_use: see it before you buy it
fitted to the design you approved
